name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 10 times in 4 visits over 21 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 21 hours starting 2026-01-28, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 3.94 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
